Anthony Maggio, Chief Product Officer at Runway, on what the electrification of factories teaches us about adopting AI. When factories first installed electric motors, productivity barely moved. They kept the layouts designed for steam, and the gains only came once a new generation redesigned the factory around the technology itself. Today the models are the electricity and companies are the factories. The teams pulling ahead aren’t bolting AI onto existing workflows. They’re rethinking what their work could look like and who gets to do it.
